answer: Issue each person one non-transferable credential only after a delayed uniqueness check, and bind one ballot to that credential. Require a refundable 3 POA bond held 30 days; forfeiture needs independent evidence and an appeal. An attacker creating N identities must pass N separate checks, wait out the delay, and immobilize 3N POA for a month, risking loss if credentials are duplicated. Required words: mirror, beacon, velvet.
